newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Siam City Cement sets US$75 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Siam City Cement sets US$75 mln loan.

text.p: Siam City Cement Public Co Ltd has launched a US$75 million term loan facility, bankers said.
They said the facility carries a maturity of five years and has an average life of 3.5 years. It pays a margin of 55 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers committing US$5 million or more is 60 basis points.
There is a tax absorption fee of 30 basis points.
NatWest Markets and Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Singapore are arrangers and joint bookrunners.
Siam City Cement completed a US$125 million five-year term loan facility last August. The deal had an average life of four years and paid an all-in return of 70 basis points to top-tier managers.
